I turn local businesses into brands people remember.

I'm M. Shafiq Ullah, a social media marketer and content creator from Pakistan. I help local businesses get found, trusted and chosen by customers in their own city, through consistent content, clear branding and campaigns built around real results.

I create content for my own audience on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube every day, so I know what holds attention and what gets scrolled past. I use that same experience to grow your business.

  • Results first

    Every post and ad has a goal: more visits, more messages, more customers.

  • Clear communication

    You always know what is being posted, why, and how it performed.

  • Reliable delivery

    Content goes out on schedule, in your brand's voice, without you chasing me.

Local media marketing

I help local shops, restaurants, clinics, academies and small brands get seen by people in their own city.

Social media management

Daily posting, replies to comments and messages, and steady growth on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.

Short video content

Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts shot and edited to show your products, staff and place.

Local ads

Paid campaigns on Meta and TikTok aimed at customers near your business.

Branding and page setup

Profile design, bio, highlights and a consistent look so your page feels trusted.

Content planning

A monthly calendar with ideas, captions and hashtags, so you always know what goes out next.

Growth reports

A simple monthly summary of reach, followers and messages, with what to do next.
